summary: The sky is the simulation's, not a clock's: the snapshot grows six read-only presentation keys (weather per region, corruption per cell as S9's band, the heat band, hour of day, the active region and night), an Atmosphere autoload maps them to sun, fog, wind, grade and night lights through a small AtmosphereTarget interface, and content/atmosphere/ owns every number.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1. Lane P2 (render foundation) runs in parallel and owns game/render/** and game/scripts/render/**; this lane touches neither. origin/lane/P2-render-foundation did not exist when the adapter was written, so EnvironmentAtmosphereTarget drives Godot's Environment and DirectionalLight3D directly and the AtmosphereTarget contract is duck-typed by method name -- P2's WorldEnvironment script implements set_sun/set_fog/set_wind/set_grade and Atmosphere prefers it over the fallback the moment it is in the tree, with no second code path to retire. game/tools/capture_review_scene.gd is EXTENDED, not copied: it takes an optional third user argument naming an authored atmosphere snapshot, so there is one capture tool. The godot_bridge.rs change is one appended block of read-only keys in the state dictionary plus its band-name helpers and tests; no ExpeditionState field is added, so EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS is untouched. Shipped: the band ladders were given as_str/ALL in dungeon.rs and clocks.rs rather than a private name table in the bridge, because WeatherCondition::as_str already existed and a second spelling would be the fork; the bridge calls them. The Rust half of the content/Rust equality check lives in strategy::dungeon::authored_atmosphere rather than in godot_bridge.rs, because godot_bridge.rs compiles only under the godot-ext feature and building a VarDictionary needs a running engine -- so `cargo test` could never reach a test written there. The six projected keys are therefore proved by `cargo check --features godot-ext` plus the full Godot gate running against the real GDExtension, and the band NAMES the keys carry are proved by the Rust tests. AtmosphereReviewBoard is review-only and wired only by the capture tool; the game has no board yet, so night lamps resolve and report unplaced.
